verses.en: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
verses.pt: Abandonai, portanto, toda malícia, toda enganação, fingimentos, invejas, e todas as falas maldosas,
verses.en_web: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
verses.en_bbe: So putting away all wrongdoing, and all tricks and deceits and envies and evil talk,

verses.en: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
verses.pt: e desejai ansiosamente, como bebês recém-nascidos, o leite da Palavra, não falsificado, para que por meio dele estejais crescendo;
verses.en_web: as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
verses.en_bbe: Be full of desire for the true milk of the word, as babies at their mothers' breasts, so that you may go on to salvation;

verses.en: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
verses.pt: se, de fato, já experimentastes que o Senhor é bom.
verses.en_web: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious:
verses.en_bbe: If you have had a taste of the grace of the Lord:

verses.en: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
verses.pt: Aproximai-vos dele, que é uma pedra viva, rejeitada pelos seres humanos, mas escolhida e preciosa para Deus.
verses.en_web: coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
verses.en_bbe: To whom you come, as to a living stone, not honoured by men, but of great and special value to God;

verses.en: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Também vós, como pedras vivas, sois edificados como casa espiritual e sacerdócio santo, para oferecerdes sacrifícios espirituais, agradáveis a Deus por meio de Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: You also, as living stones, are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: You, as living stones, are being made into a house of the spirit, a holy order of priests, making those offerings of the spirit which are pleasing to God through Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
verses.pt: Por isso também está contido na Escritura: Eis que eu ponho em Sião uma pedra principal de esquina, escolhida e preciosa. Quem nela crer de maneira nenhuma será envergonhado. Isaías 28:16
verses.en_web: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen, and precious: He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
verses.en_bbe: Because it is said in the Writings, See, I am placing a keystone in Zion, of great and special value; and the man who has faith in him will not be put to shame.

verses.en: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
verses.pt: Assim, para vós, que credes, ela é preciosa. Mas para os rebeldes: A pedra que os construtores rejeitaram, essa se tornou a principal de esquina, Salmo 118:22
verses.en_web: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected, has become the chief cornerstone,”
verses.en_bbe: And the value is for you who have faith; but it is said for those without faith, The very stone which the builders put on one side, was made the chief stone of the building;

verses.en: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
verses.pt: assim como pedra de tropeço, e pedra que causa queda. Eles tropeçam na palavra por serem rebeldes. Para isso eles foram destinados. Isaías 8:14
verses.en_web: and, “a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
verses.en_bbe: And, A stone of falling, a rock of trouble; the word is the cause of their fall, because they go against it, and this was the purpose of God.

verses.en: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
verses.pt: Mas vós sois a geração escolhida, o sacerdócio real, a nação santa, o povo adquirido; a fim de que anuncieis as virtudes daquele que vos chamou das trevas para a sua maravilhosa luz.
verses.en_web: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light:
verses.en_bbe: But you are a special people, a holy nation, priests and kings, a people given up completely to God, so that you may make clear the virtues of him who took you out of the dark into the light of heaven.

verses.en: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
verses.pt: Antes, vós não éreis povo, mas agora sois povo de Deus. Antes, não havíeis recebido misericórdia, mas agora recebestes misericórdia.
verses.en_web: who in time past were no people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
verses.en_bbe: In the past you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; then there was no mercy for you, but now mercy has been given to you.

verses.en: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
verses.pt: Amados, como a peregrinos e estrangeiros, eu vos peço que vos abstenhais dos desejos carnais, que batalham contra a alma,
verses.en_web: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
verses.en_bbe: My loved ones, I make this request with all my heart, that, as those for whom this world is a strange country, you will keep yourselves from the desires of the flesh which make war against the soul;

verses.en: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
verses.pt: e que tenhais um bom comportamento vosso entre os pagãos; para que, naquilo que de vós, como de malfeitores, falam mal, no dia da visitação glorifiquem a Deus por causa das vossas boas obras que tiverem visto.
verses.en_web: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they see, glorify God in the day of visitation.
verses.en_bbe: Being of good behaviour among the Gentiles; so that though they say now that you are evil-doers, they may see your good works and give glory to God when he comes to be their judge.

verses.en: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
verses.pt: Portanto sujeitai-vos a toda autoridade humana, por causa do Senhor; seja ao rei, como superior;
verses.en_web: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
verses.en_bbe: Keep all the laws of men because of the Lord; those of the king, who is over all,

verses.en: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
verses.pt: seja aos governantes, como enviados por ele, com o objetivo de castigar os malfeitores, e de conceder honra aos que fazem o bem.
verses.en_web: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
verses.en_bbe: And those of the rulers who are sent by him for the punishment of evil-doers and for the praise of those who do well.

verses.en: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
verses.pt: Pois esta é a vontade de Deus, que, ao fazerdes o bem, caleis a ignorância dos homens tolos.
verses.en_web: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
verses.en_bbe: Because it is God's pleasure that foolish and narrow-minded men may be put to shame by your good behaviour:

verses.en: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
verses.pt: Comportai-vos como pessoas livres, mas não useis a liberdade como pretexto para a malícia. Em vez disso, sede como servos de Deus.
verses.en_web: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
verses.en_bbe: As those who are free, not using your free position as a cover for wrongdoing, but living as the servants of God;

verses.en: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
verses.pt: Honrai a todos: amai aos irmãos, temei a Deus, honrai ao rei.
verses.en_web: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
verses.en_bbe: Have respect for all, loving the brothers, fearing God, honouring the king.

verses.en: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
verses.pt: Servos, sujeitai-vos com todo temor aos vossos senhores, não somente aos bons e brandos, mas também aos que maltratam.
verses.en_web: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: Servants, take orders from your masters with all respect; not only if they are good and gentle, but even if they are bad-humoured.

verses.en: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
verses.pt: Pois coisa agradável é se alguém, por causa da consciência a respeito de Deus, experimente dores, sofrendo injustamente.
verses.en_web: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
verses.en_bbe: For it is a sign of grace if a man, desiring to do right in the eyes of God, undergoes pain as punishment for something which he has not done.

verses.en: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
verses.pt: Afinal, que mérito há em suportar serdes espancados por cometerdes pecado? Contudo, se, quando fazeis o bem, sois afligidos e suportais, isso é a Deus.
verses.en_web: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
verses.en_bbe: What credit is it if, when you have done evil, you take your punishment quietly? but if you are given punishment for doing right, and take it quietly, this is pleasing to God.

verses.en: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
verses.pt: Pois para isto fostes chamados, porque também Cristo sofreu por nós, deixando-nos exemplo, para que sigais os seus passos.
verses.en_web: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
verses.en_bbe: This is God's purpose for you: because Jesus himself underwent punishment for you, giving you an example, so that you might go in his footsteps:

verses.en: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
verses.pt: Ele não cometeu pecado, nem engano foi achado em sua boca.
verses.en_web: who did not sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
verses.en_bbe: Who did no evil, and there was no deceit in his mouth:

verses.en: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
verses.pt: Quando o insultavam, ele não insultava de volta. Quando sofria, ele não ameaçava; em vez disso, entregava-se ao que julga de maneira justa.
verses.en_web: Who, when he was cursed, didn’t curse back. When he suffered, didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
verses.en_bbe: To sharp words he gave no sharp answer; when he was undergoing pain, no angry word came from his lips; but he put himself into the hands of the judge of righteousness:

verses.en: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
verses.pt: Ele levou nossos pecados em seu próprio corpo sobre o madeiro; para que nós, estando mortos para os pecados, vivamos para a justiça. Pela ferida dele fostes sarados.
verses.en_web: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.
verses.en_bbe: He took our sins on himself, giving his body to be nailed on the tree, so that we, being dead to sin, might have a new life in righteousness, and by his wounds we have been made well.

verses.en: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
verses.pt: Porque vós éreis como ovelhas desviadas do caminho; mas agora vós estais convertidos ao Pastor e Supervisor de vossas almas.
verses.en_web: For you were going astray like sheep; but now have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
verses.en_bbe: Because, like sheep, you had gone out of the way; but now you have come back to him who keeps watch over your souls.
